ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and inner lobes are dominated by low-intensity black pigmentation; high-intensity white pigmentation is localized at the distal tips of both lobes, extending inward approximately 20-25% of the lobe length with a high-frequency mottled transition zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 105 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire margin; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys is most pronounced on the distal thirds of each lobe, with several distinct indentations exceeding 5 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderate concave curve from the median notch to the tips, while the leading edge exhibits a strong convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels concentrated at the distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the dark pigmentation of the left lobe (viewer's perspective), breaking the continuous low-intensity surface mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located approximately halfway between the median notch and the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical mottling pattern where high-intensity white pixels on the right lobe distal tip form a more contiguous block compared to the more fragmented 'salt-and-pepper' distribution on the left lobe tip.
